body.intent: Fix tests write fake usage-limit hits into the machine's real root: Ctx.Wd is empty in internal/api tests (testCtx), so limitsDir's rootcfg.Find("") resolves the process cwd, the package dir inside a checkout under the root (~/code), and usage_learn_test's usage-fake hits land in ~/code/.rhiza-root/usage.limits.jsonl; the live root daemon then held every run for a day on a fake weekly hit (and learned fake limits). Root resolution must never escape a test's temp dir: tests must set Wd (or RHIZA_ROOT-style isolation) to their temp dir, and a test must fail if anything is written outside it
